subject: Mobile Development
title: Cloud Sync: Your Data Everywhere
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Cloud Sync: Your Data Everywhere.

hook.text: You take a photo on your phone. Seconds later it appears on your tablet and laptop.

buildup.text: Cloud sync uploads data to remote servers and pushes it to all your connected devices.

discovery.text: iCloud, Google Drive, and Dropbox handle sync transparently in the background.

twist.text: Sync conflicts happen when two devices edit the same file offline simultaneously.

climax.text: Seamless sync makes devices feel like windows into one unified digital life.

punchline.text: Your data lives in the cloud, shown on every screen.

quiz.question: What causes cloud sync conflicts?
options: Two devices editing the same file offline
